scripts.build: npm --prefix ./backend/ run build && npm --prefix ./frontend/ run build:docs-search-index && npm --prefix ./frontend/ run build
scripts.lint: (npm --prefix ./backend run lint 2>&1 | sed 's/^/[backend] /') & (npm --prefix ./frontend run lint 2>&1 | sed 's/^/[frontend] /') & wait
scripts.test: npm --prefix ./backend/ run test && npm --prefix ./frontend/ run test
